definitions: A personal stake or involvement in an undertaking or state of affairs, especially one that brings the possibility of financial gain or other advantage.
A special concern in the well-being of something or someone, due to personal gain.
examples: The politician clearly had a vested interest in the new zoning laws.
As a major shareholder, she had a vested interest in the company's success.
Many people with a vested interest in the old system resisted the changes.
